content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (the product) gives precursors (retro). The description: carbonyl-ene reaction intramolecular forming five-membered ring, converting ketone and alkene to hydroxyl and new C-C bond. So the product is a cyclic alcohol (five-membered) with a hydroxyl. The given SMILES includes a fluorinated carbon (CF3) attached to a carbon in the ring? Let's parse: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

So there is an alkene between C1 and C2, C2 attached to aromatic ring (c3...). C2 also attached to chiral carbon C9 which is part of a cyclobutane? Actually C9 is attached to a 5-membered ring: C9 attached to CH2-CH2-CH2-C13 (which is chiral) forming a 5-membered? Let's see: C9 is attached to CH2 (10) then CH2 (11) then CH2 (12) then C13 which is attached to OH and CF3. So that is a 5-membered ring (C9-10-11-12-13). So product is a cyclic alcohol (five-membered) with CF3 substituent.

The retro step would break the C-O bond (forming carbonyl) and break C-C bond (forming alkene). So we need a template for carbonyl-ene retro (i.e., forward is carbonyl-ene, retro is reverse). Template likely involves breaking C-O and forming C=O and C=C.

We need to search for templates that involve functional groups broken: ketone (C=O) formed, C=C formed; functional groups formed: ketone, C-C double bond; broken: aliphatic hydroxyl, five-membered ring. But the search tool expects forward reaction criteria. For retrosynthesis, we specify functional groups broken in forward (i.e., present in product) and formed in forward (i.e., present in precursors). The product has hydroxyl and five-membered ring; forward reaction consumes those (breaks them) to give ketone and alkene. So functional_groups_broken: aliphatic hydroxyls, five-membered rings. functional_groups_formed: ketones, C-C double bonds. Also bonds broken: C-O, C-C (in ring). bonds formed: C=O, C=C.

Let's try search with those criteria.
